Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. The decider will take place on 15th September, 2017. Action begins at 1900 local time (1400 GMT). We look forward to your company. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Faf du Plessis says that they needed the win to keep the series alive. Is happy that they made less mistakes. Credits Thisara Perera for playing a great knock. Lauds the effort by Hashim Amla to play the anchor role. Adds that you take losses in your stride but they were disappointed with their performance last night. Is delighted that the bowlers executed their plans well and hopes that they do well in the final game.

Sarfraz Ahmed starts by crediting the opposition, especially Amla for the way he took the game away from them. Feels it's a good learning for the young bowlers on how to bowl in pressure situations when you have someone like Amla batting. Reckons their sloppiness in the field cost them the game. Opines that yorker is fruitful at the death but at the same time you need to hit the right lengths by varying your pace.

Man of the Match, Thisara Perera is really delighted that he was selected for the World XI side. Is short of words and is extremely happy with his contribution. Credits Amla who asked him to keep his calm at the start and cash in at the right time. Once again emphasizes that it was a dream come true for him to be a part of the World XI side.

Pakistan will rue the fact that they were really sloppy in the field and the missed chances didn't help either. Agreed, they did well at the start but in such a crunch game you just can't hold back. The spinners once again kept it tight for them but the fact that Shadab Khan went wicketless should be a worry for them. Rumman Raees and Sohail Khan couldn't stop the rampage at the death as they wilted under pressure. Overall, it was a cracking game of cricket. Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony...

Thisara Perera's heroics have done it for the World XI! 47 from just 19 balls, just one dot ball. Kudos to him! Chasing 175, the visitors got off to a good start. Hashim Amla decided to bat through and when that happens, the opposition is always in trouble. He scored a breezy 72 and remained unbeaten. He kept on stitching partnerships in the middle, but his unbeaten stand of 69 with Perera sealed the deal for his side and leveled the series 1-1.

SIX! Game, set, match! Thisara Perera, you beauty! Everybody is feeling the pressure but not him. Full toss from Raees, a gift in context of the game, Perera gets under it and just dumps it over the head of the bowler for a biggie. He is delighted that he has got his team over the line. World XI win by 7 wickets!
Sarfraz Ahmed comes over for a chat with his bowler.
Shorter in length, Amla pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 6 needed in 2 balls. Will Perera go for glory?

In the air but safe! Raees bowls a length ball around middle, Amla looks to go big but gets it off the toe end. The ball falls in no man's land near mid on. Two runs taken. Amla is down on his knees, tired. 7 needed in 3 balls.
Full and wide outside off, hit to long off who does well this time to keep them down to a single. 9 needed in 4 balls.

Very full around off, Perera drives it through mid off. The fielder in the deep, Shadab Khan misfields and allows the second run. Sarfraz Ahmed is not happy since Khan is not even getting to the ball. Two runs taken.
WIDE! Pressure, pressure! Raees bowls it outside off, very wide, Perera lets it go. A wide signaled.
Final over of the game. Can Raees defend 12?
Just a single off the final ball. Very full, Thisara could only jam it out towards long off. He'll keep strike. 20 off the over! 13 needed from the final over.

SIX! That's clubbed! Pakistan now look clueless! Khan serves a full toss on middle, Perera clears his front leg to slog it away. He connects and connects well to thump it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum. 19 already from the over!

Dropped! Malik is the culprit! Fuller length delivery on the stumps, Perera chips it down towards long off. Shoaib Malik gets across to his left but spills it out. To make matters worse, they run two. It's all happening here in Lahore.
Yorker on the stumps, jammed past the bowler down the ground for a brace.
Wide! Pressure! Slower ball, slanting away, Thisara still goes after it but misses.

A better throw was needed! Fuller again on the pads, whipped uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. Shadab Khan throws it at the wrong end, the striker's end since Amla was tiring at the bowler's end. Two runs picked up.
SIX! A biggie to start the penultimate over! Fuller ball on middle and leg, Perera bashes it down the ground over long on for a biggie.

Well bowled! Amla tries to be innovative here. Walks across to this length delivery and tries to scoop it over the keeper. Lack of pace on it meant that it's another dot ball. 33 runs needed from 12 balls.
Back of the hand delivery, shorter in length. Amla is early into his pull shot and is beaten all ends up.
Short ball on middle, swatted through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! That will do for World XI! Raees serves a low full toss on the pads, Thisara Perera clears his front leg and smashes it over long on for a maximum.
Spears in a yorker on the stumps, jammed down the ground for just a single.
A dot ball! Cleverly bowled! Slower one, angling in, Amla makes room to swing it across the line but is undone by the lack of pace on it. Gets beaten.
Good ball to end the over! Yorker on middle and leg, Amla could only jam it out down to long on for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid-on. They pick up a single.

SIX! In the air... and over the fence! Slower one around the pads, Perera gives it a full swing of the bat. However, it seemed like he will get caught but the ball sails over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum. Pressure-release shot?
Khan sticks to the fuller length delivery on middle and leg, Amla whips it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on off, driven through mid off for a single.

Yes! It is a bump ball! Fuller ball on the stumps, Perera swings across the line but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball lobs back to the bowler who takes it. He then appeals for a catch but the umpire goes upstairs. He gives the soft signal as NOT OUT! Replays show it clearly bumped into the turf. A dot ball, nonetheless.
Is that out? Sohail Khan is claiming a catch off his own bowling. Is it a bump ball?
Sohail Khan is brought back into the attack. 51 needed off 24 balls.
FOUR! All too easy for Amla! Fuller ball, sprayed on the pads and Amla is too good to miss out on that one. Clips it down to the fine leg fence to end the over with a boundary.
Slower back of the hand delivery outside off, Hashim looks to cut it away but fails to do so.
FOUR! What a hit! Raees goes for the yorker, misses it just by an inch. Amla clears his front leg and whips it over the cow corner for a one bounce boundary.
Angles it in on the pads, Perera looks to tuck it away but gets it off the thigh pad towards the off side. A run taken.
Fuller on middle and leg, whipped through backward square leg for a single.
Sloppy from Malik! This will not please the skipper. On the shorter side, Amla cuts it towards Malik at backward point who fumbles and that allows the batsmen to pinch another one.
Rumman Raees comes back on for a bowl.

Slower through the air around middle, turning away, Amla flicks it through mid-wicket to see off Khan's spell. His figures read 4-0-32-0! So, he goes wicketless tonight! 6 singles from the over. 63 needed from 30 balls.
Comes down the track and almost yorks himself there. Jammed out towards long on for another single.
Drags his length back a bit, it's punched through the off side for another single.
Makes room and blasts it through covers for a single.
Around middle and off, driven towards cover for a single.
Fires it full on off, jammed towards point for a single.
Time for Thisara Perera, he can hit the ball big.

OUT! Nawaz strikes! One shot too many? Certainly feel so as Faf as thrown it away. Tossed up delivery on middle and off, du Plessis once again looks to go big but slices it in the air over cover. Shadab Khan in the deep takes a well-judged reverse cup catch over his head. Big wicket for the hosts.

SIX! Boom! Tossed up delivery around off, du Plessis comes running down the track and goes on with his lofted shot down the ground. The man at long off, Rumman Raees leaps to catch it but the ball goes well over him and into the fence.
Around the leg stump line, nudged in front of square for one.
In the air... safe! Faf gets across the play the paddle scoop but gets it off the top edge. Sohail Khan at short fine leg comes running in but the ball falls short of him. Only a single taken.
Goes deep in the crease and flicks it in front of square on the leg side for a single.

Fifty up for Amla, his 7th in this format! Quicker and around middle and leg, Amla comes down the track and flicks it wide of long on for a couple. Just a raise of the bat from Hashim. In fact, wait! Only a single will be counted as du Plessis is found guilty for running one short.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total. 10 runs from the over! 79 needed from 42 balls.
Around off, punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! That's gone the distance! Floats it up on the stumps, Faf du Plessis dances down the track and goes bang over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards long off for one.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Excellent fielding! Tossed up around middle, du Plessis gets down and slog sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Nawaz in the deep makes a great stop. Just a single taken.
Flatter and skidding through the surface, Amla looks to tuck it away but misses and is hit on the pads. A loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Maybe, going down leg.
SIX! Much-needed one! Loops it up around off, Hashim Amla gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it over long off. Good timing behind the shot as the ball sails over the fence for a biggie.
Leading edge... safe! Flatter through the air, angling in, Amla looks to work it away but gets it off the leading edge. The fielder at cover was interested but the ball falls well short of him.
Darts it around off, Faf du Plessis dances down the track and drills it down to long off for a single.
Du Plesssis makes room, the spinner follows him. The skipper gets an inside edge through the legs as Sarfraz stops it with a move to his left.
Drops it short around middle, turning away a bit. Amla turns it through the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Mohammad Nawaz is back into the attack. 97 needed from 54 balls.

Floats it outside off, Amla drives it towards cover-point and takes off. The fielder is slow to react and it allows Faf to get in. Sarfraz does not like it one bit and lets his feelings known to his teammate.
Shorter in length, punched through covers for a single.

Is that out? Nope! Flatter around off, Amla punches it towards short third man and takes a quick single. The fielder fires a throw at the striker's end and the keeper takes the bails off. Faf was in an awkward position trying to get into the crease. It is referred upstairs and replays find him just fine. That was more than close though.
Third umpire is referred for a run out appeal.
Turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter outside off, Amla looks to punch but gets an outside edge towards short third man. The throw is a quick one and hence Khan is taken aback by the pace on that one.
Turns one through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter outside off, punched towards covers by the batsman.
Gets it wide of the diving Shadab Khan at cover for a single.
Played back to the bowler by du Plessis. Sarfraz screams to the bowler to push Hashim Amla a bit since Imad had to dive there.
Loops it outside off, spins away for a change. Wasim does not turn the ball usually. Faf is beaten and even he is surprised.
Faf du Plessis comes out to bat. World XI need him to play a big one here.

OUT! Can't do anything about it! Wasim bowls it around middle and leg, does not get up at all. Paine is on his back foot to cut it but can't counter the low bounce. The ball hits the leg stump and Paine has to go back to the hut. He has not had a good time so far. 104 needed in 64 balls.
Shorter in length, punched to covers for a single. That was actually sliced off the bat.
Leg spinner this time, Paine plays for the slider and is hence beaten. He has looked out of sorts so far.
In the air but safe! Khan bowls it outside off, spins away, Amla is beaten by the wrong 'un but gets it safely at covers for a single.
Googly outside off, Paine punches it towards covers for a single.
Flatter around middle and leg, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Fuller in length on middle and leg, Amla sits low and just sweeps it over the square leg fence for a maximum. That was needed. 108 needed in 70 balls.
Shorter in length, pulled over mid-wicket for a single.
Time for Shadab Khan!

Could that be costly? Punches it to Shadab Khan at covers and takes off. The fielder fails to pick it up and that allows Amla to get into his crease and complete the run. That could be a costly chance missed.
Nudges it towards mid on for a quick single. The bowler tried to stop it but failed to stop it.
Amla looks to turn one through the leg side but gets it off the face of the bat. Hint of turn there.
Short in length, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter in length around middle, chopped towards point by the batsman.
Lands it around off, punched to long on for a single.
Imad Wasim returns for a bowl.
Fires it around the pads, Paine fails to clip it through and is hit on his pads. The bowler appeals for some reason.

FOUR! What should have been a catch is now a boundary! Nawaz bowls it around off, Paine scoops it over short fine leg. Sohail Khan never thinks of the catch and just ambles after the ball. Ends up watching it go into the ropes for a boundary.
Similar length again, punched to long on for a single.
Shoaib Malik is off the field. He seems to have hurt his fingers after taking Iqbal's catch. The physio is attending him near the dugout...
Shorter outside off, Amla shapes to cut hard but fails to connect with the bat.
Flatter outside off, Paine punches it down the wicket. The bowler half-stops it and parries it towards mid on. A single taken at the end.
Shorter in length around middle, Amla works it towards long on for a single.
Bowling change as Mohammad Nawaz comes on to bowl.
Slower outside off, cut hard towards point by Paine.
Nudges it through backward square leg for a single. They have bowled far too much on the pads of the batsmen.
Good length around middle, turned towards mid-wicket.
Tim Paine is the new man in.

OUT! What a catch, Malik! Khan bowls it around leg on a length, Iqbal thinks it's a boundary-ball and looks to flick it through fine leg. Malik reacts brilliantly to it at short fine leg and takes it to his right with a dive. Interesting field placement but a wicket gifted to Pakistan? Tamim Iqbal has to depart.
Similar length, Amla punches it towards mid off and takes a quick single. Amla took it casually as he had got in, but it could have been interesting.
Good length around middle and leg, Amla works it through the square leg region with a pull. Shehzad goes to his right and does well to stop the ball despite slipping a touch. Two runs taken.
Sohail Khan returns.
Fuller in length, Tamim drives it back down the wicket. The bowler stops it with his left boot and Iqbal has to get back into his crease.
Good length on the pads, Amla tucks it through square leg for a single.
Nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
An action replay of the similar delivery, just that this time the mid on fielder gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the striker's end but no harm done.
Good length around off, Iqbal defends it coming forward to the left of the bowler.
Bowls it around middle and leg, turned through backward square leg for a single.
Time for a change. Rumman Raees brought on for a bowl.
Drifts it around leg, turned towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Length ball around off, Amla just shows the straight face of the bat and gets it wide of the mid off fielder for a boundary.
On the pads, but thankfully for the bowler, Amla finds the fielder at short fine leg with his clip shot.
FOUR! Slapped! Good length around off, Amla stands tall and punches it through covers for a boundary. That was a shot of a man in top form.

Bowls it around middle, gets it to zip through, Iqbal looks to clip it but is hit on his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and the batsmen take a leg bye. Stifled appeal turned down as it always looked a touch high.
Shorter in length around middle, worked towards mid-wicket. There is a fumble which makes Amla think but he settles for the single.
Time for the debutante, Usman Khan.

FOUR! Connects this time! Wasim fires it outside off, Iqbal sits down and just smacks it wide of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Expensive over from Wasim and World XI are off to a good start.
Gets across to paddle this one over short fine leg but gets hit on his pads.
Heaved! Iqbal comes down the wicket and heaves one wide of mid-wicket for a couple of runs. A very good effort in the deep by Shehzad.
Fires it around off from over the wicket, Tamim clips it in the air but the ball drops short of the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Smart batting! Expects Tamim to back away and drifts it on the pads, Imad. Iqbal is smart to get inside the line and just paddles it into the fine leg fence for a boundary.
SIX! BOOM goes Tamim! Wasim lands it around middle, Iqbal gives himself room and goes through with his lofted shot over the head of the bowler. The connection is superb and a maximum results.
FOUR! Top shot! Good length again, Amla just stands tall and wrists it through mid-wicket. The timing is so good that he gets a boundary. Amla special, that.
Good length around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length around off and middle, clipped wide of mid on for a single.
Turns it through the leg side for a single to rotate the strike.
Low full toss outside off, Iqbal drives it well but to the fielder at covers.
Length ball around middle, Iqbal clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Sedate start this.
Sohail Khan to bowl from the other end.
Angles it into the pads, Amla clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
Shorter outside off, punched to covers by Hashim.
Flatter in trajectory, Tamim makes room and punches it towards long on for a run.
Shorter in length, punched past the diving mid on fielder for a single.
Loops it outside off, Tamim pushes it towards covers for a single to get off the mark.
Flatter around leg, Iqbal paddles it to the short fine leg fielder.
Welcome back for the chase. Out come the World XI openers - Tamim Iqbal and Hashim Amla. Imad Wasim to start off with bowling proceedings. Let's play...
